front.title: Enforcement Attestation Receipts for AI Inference and Agent Action Decisions

abstract.t: This document specifies two compact JSON records, signed with Ed25519 and verifiable offline under a pinned public key. The first is an attestation receipt for an AI inference decision, binding an outcome to a request hash. The second, added in this revision, is an action record: the decision an enforcement point takes before an agent's proposed tool call or other state-changing action runs, whether that decision is to allow or to refuse. An action record is signed by the enforcement point, never by the agent, and binds the decision to a hash of the exact canonical arguments proposed. The document also describes how a human approval can be bound to exact action values with single use and expiry, how either record could be carried as a COSE_Sign1 Signed Statement and registered with a SCITT Transparency Service, and where the current format does not yet do so. Both formats are intended for settings where an operator-controlled log is not, on its own, sufficient evidence of the decision.
